idea-plugin.name: Unity CLI Test Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Unity CLI Test Runner: run Unity Test Framework tests from Rider without opening the Unity Editor UI.

Uses the official Unity CLI in batch mode (unity test): headless Editor, Test Runner, and NUnit report, then surfaces results in Rider's Unit Tests window.

Supports Edit Mode, Play Mode, and Player targets.

Coexistence: works alongside the bundled Unity Support plugin. Existing gutters, discovery, and "Unity Editor - Edit/Play Mode" runners stay intact; this plugin only adds headless CLI execution.
